description: External API reference document for port 8791. Documents: authentication via X-API-Key header, rate limiting (60 req/min/key), read-only endpoints for verdict lookup (GET /verdict/{mcp_name}), signal scores (GET /signals/{mcp_name}), threat associations (GET /threats/{mcp_name}). Includes example curl commands, JSON response shapes per mcp_server_registry columns, and error codes. Does not document write or admin endpoints (internal only).
